svg.title: Structure Prediction — EnzyMind quick start
svg.desc: Structure Prediction. Paste a protein sequence or choose a FASTA record. Inspect the 3D model and local pLDDT confidence. Screenshots show the current interface with an actual service response to the public example. Input and result excerpts are arranged for readability; numerical values are unchanged.
